title: Practice forgiveness until fear loses its stage
summary: The wound loses authority when forgiveness joins conduct and contentment. Fear thins because the heart no longer has to guard its grievance.
takeaway: Let the guarded wound lose its command through forgiveness.
lifeApplication: Notice where the body is preparing to defend the old injury. Release one claim you keep guarding and let contentment occupy that space instead.

source.shortMeaning: Forgiveness thins fear because the heart stops guarding its injury as identity.
source.lifeApplication: When fear is living inside the grudge, release one claim and watch what softens.

evidence.coreClaim: Forgiveness thins fear because the heart stops guarding its injury as identity.
evidence.turn: The same fast of forgiveness becomes a second invitation — stop treating the injury as the self.
evidence.practicalImplication: Notice where the body is preparing to defend the old injury. Release one claim you keep guarding and let contentment occupy that space instead.
